scope: Two new pure working/reference helper recipe and test files
Maintained lifecycle RFC and sanitized source evidence

review.kind: Delegated release-engineering preparation and primary implementation/failure-boundary review

checks.windows_skip_scope: New Linux-only temporary descriptor/filesystem script mechanics

limitations: Generated recipes and temporary Linux script tests only; no real container, named volume, original-image interpreter or live seeding was exercised.

Fixed /usr/bin/python3 requires original-pin compatibility verification. Empty Env/Volumes do not prove inheritance cleared; Python isolation flags do not establish image filesystem or dynamic-loader safety.
NoCopy controls copy-up, not volume freshness or implicit creation. Ordinary local volumes have no immutable object ID; successful create, names, labels and timestamps do not establish ownership.

Partial files and all helpers remain retained. The working helper conflicts with existing all-container volume exclusivity; a finite exact-ID/config/mount/seed/stopped-state lab-only allowance is pending. Production exclusivity is unchanged.
Auxiliary v1 has no helper lifecycle or working-volume record. Versioned create/start/terminal intents/receipts and persistence are not implemented by this recipe.

Exit zero and report bytes are not controller acceptance. A report can escape before a flush failure; exact terminal status and independent bounded reinspection with continuous control remain required.

Advisory locks and observed identities do not exclude arbitrary privileged writers. Boot/socket/root-peer/daemon-process and backing-directory/mount continuity must be independently maintained; engine ID alone is insufficient.

Source preparation grants no execution authority. VM/console/operator scope, image/runtime, attributable creation, continuity/reconciliation, full harness, global release/lint, H7/W16, Coordinator and private-backup gates remain open.
